What are evals?

Also known as testing, benchmarking, perf measurement, etc

Evals involve the following:

01

Model or “agent”

02

Environment

  • Could be just their own context
  • May be a docker container, sandbox, etc
03

Grader

(code, LLM judge, human)

Testing in software

In the before times…

  • Writing unit tests served as friction
  • That friction helped write more testable software
  • This helped improve code quality significantly

Not perfect -“every bug in production passed all the tests to get there”

Evals in AI powered software

Writing evals help you

01

Define the performance axes you care about

02

Break up the problem into smaller ideas

03

Understand where complexity helps and hurts

04

Build more malleable systems

Still not perfect

A number you can score after every change

AccuracyPass rateCost per ticketTrigger rate
Hillclimbing

The hillclimbing loop

  • One change per round
  • Keep it if train and test improve
  • Otherwise, revert

GEPA (prompt optimization)

A hillclimbing loop for prompts, and one of the most effective
